search_invariant: A shared 11-class linear head is trained only on seed-366000 latent tokens to classify the current token as digit 0--9 or non-digit. Foundation uses the width-64 seven-digit beam. ASCENT uses the same beam and probability gate, constrained only by the longest digit prefix decoded from the charged latent state. Evaluation seed 366803 is never used to fit the probe. Raw source IDs are labels during probe training but are unavailable to the evaluation decoder.
primary_metric: NVIDIA RULER string_match_all under a learned ASCENT latent-evidence head plus matched numeric generation
development_gate: ASCENT's paired official-score point estimate must be positive at every endpoint and strictly increase across both adjacent scale transitions. A favorable curve requires three newly generated untouched confirmation seeds, a refit only on the immutable seed-366000 training set, positive adjacent cluster intervals, and a positive seed-clustered log-parameter slope interval.
interpretation: The learned evidence head is a 11*(d_s+1)-parameter post-training ASCENT decoder and must be counted in parameter/compute controls. The episodic state itself is only 20/23/25 model-width latent tokens and has a decreasing state/model ratio. The protocol remains a short query plus external memory bridge, not a full-context leaderboard score. FPVM excluded.
